transport: curl --fail --location --output from commit-pinned raw.githubusercontent.com URLs; no fixture edits, added headers, newline conversion, or regeneration

files.generationNotes: The tracked file is vendored unchanged, not regenerated. Upstream flattens program newlines to spaces, prints one input line and one line per output, then a blank separator; regex examples go to the separate manonig.test, outside this bootstrap corpus.

attribution.changes: No changes to upstream fixture or COPYING bytes. Local parser, tests, metadata, and runner are separate files.

protocol.programAndInput: Exactly one physical line each; no fixture-level backslash continuations or multiline JSON. The immediate input line is not comment-filtered.
protocol.outputs: Zero or more physical JSON lines until blank/comment line or EOF; duplicate outputs retained in order.
protocol.errors: Compile failure blocks contain diagnostic lines, not input JSON. %%FAIL checks multiline diagnostics; %%FAIL IGNORE MSG ignores diagnostic matching but still requires compilation to fail.
protocol.conditionals: There are no fixture-level conditional or version directives in this pinned runner. have_decnum checks and jq if/then/else expressions remain program text. #if-like lines are ordinary comments, never skip rules.
protocol.unsupported: Unknown %%/!! directives remain explicit non-runnable cases. Malformed JSON or structure remains in the census. A dangling recognized directive is retained as a missingProgram case instead of being silently lost like the C runner.
protocol.json: Raw text preserves all decimal digits and non-finite literals. Shape validation accepts a leading BOM and whole jq non-finite tokens; it never converts fixture values for execution.

census.policy: Every active fixture is registered as a failing conformance test until an evaluator exists. Compile rejection cannot count as a pass at M0. The report is derived from parsed cases, not this metadata census.

nonRunnableArtifacts.reason: Upstream comments out this eval-dependent keyword-test recipe; the upstream runner ignores all these lines. Preserved unchanged in the vendored file.
Second commented-out eval-dependent keyword-test recipe; not an active upstream test and not represented as a skip or pass.

executionEnvironment.jqDriver: Upstream supplies -L tests/modules. Module-dependent programs are retained, not excluded; module support/assets are not implemented at M0.
executionEnvironment.manualDriver: Upstream sets PAGER=less for env.PAGER and LC_ALL=C. These programs remain in the denominator; no host environment is read by the pure-Dart parser.
